title: 第七章 这什么馅的啊第八章 这就成了
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
叶晚秋将根部切下来，随手丢进院子里，上面的叶子洗干净，切碎备用。
起火热锅，加入今天从猪腿上剔下来的猪油，慢慢熬化，将油渣捞出来。
碗里打入鸡蛋，用筷子搅散，倒进热油锅里。
用筷子不停搅动，使得锅里的鸡蛋液变成鸡蛋碎。
鸡蛋碎要嫩嫩的才好吃，凝固之后就可以停火了，锅底的余温还会继续加热。
叶晚秋将切碎的野菜倒进去，刚才捞出来的猪油渣也倒进去，稍微这么一拌，馅料的香味就散发出来了。
这小馅料，包饺子，包包子，包鞋底子都好吃！
面粉加入凉水搅成面絮，用手揉成比较软的面团，就可以准备擀皮包饺子了。
叶晚秋将面团揪成大小均匀地面剂子，准备擀皮的时候才发现没有擀面杖。
她转悠一圈，落在院子里没有用完的竹子上。
圆滚滚的，勉强也能用。
叶晚秋努力掰了个合适的长度，用小刀将不平整的地方稍微削一削，放开水里煮一下，最简单的擀面杖就有了。
她搬来把椅子，坐在桌子前擀皮，包饺子……
在现代的时候，她也经常做这样的事情。
孙子孙女喜欢吃她做的虾仁大饺子，叶晚秋一大早就要去海鲜市场，买最新鲜的虾，亲自动手处理干净，剥出虾仁。
玉米是菜市场新鲜的，买来的用手将玉米粒剥下来。
猪肉也要最新鲜的，做出来的肉馅才够鲜甜。
那老头子说绞肉机打出来的肉馅不好吃，要用菜刀，肉馅才能更香。
可是叶晚秋让他们帮忙的时候，每个人都有自己的事情要做。
最终剁肉馅的活还是落在了叶晚秋的身上。

客厅里是孙子孙女玩闹的笑声，电视机里影视剧的声音，短视频的喧闹，只有她一个人，站在厨房里，一个个擀皮，一个个包好……
虽然现在茅草屋里也只有她一个人，但叶晚秋觉得不一样了。
明明和游星她们算不上多熟悉，对这个世界也很陌生，但是叶晚秋觉得这里比‘家’要更加温暖。
很快，一个个胖乎乎的饺子整齐码放在案板上。
烧水，水开之后下饺子。
等所有的饺子变得圆滚滚的，漂在沸腾的水面上，那就意味着煮熟了。
素馅的饺子煮的时间不用太长，滚上那么两三次就熟了。
叶晚秋将饺子盛出来，给夏景景发信号，告诉她们晚饭已经做好了。
很快，夏景景的身影出现在院子里。
“婆婆！今天晚上吃什么啊！”
“饺子！”叶晚秋向她展示桌子上的饺子，一个个圆滚滚，胖嘟嘟，隔着皮能隐约看到里面的内馅。
夏景景不免咽了咽口水：“这也太香了吧……”
叶晚秋视线落在她身后，“景景，怎么就你自己？向阳和小湛呢？不吃晚饭啦？”
“崔师兄在炼丹，说是要一直守着，不然容易炼坏，那些药材好像还挺贵的。陈师兄在练剑，叫什么，废寝忘食！”
反正她是做不到的，之前门派里没有人做饭，哪怕是做出来的饭也不好吃。
现在婆婆都跟着她们一起回来了，做的饭还这么香，谁能忍得住啊。
叶晚秋沉默片刻，说：“那景景你给他们带回去，炼丹练剑什么多累啊，怎么能不吃饭？还有那小星，闭关也是要吃饭的吧？你给她也带一份……”
content_en:
Ye Wanqiu cut off the roots and threw them into the yard. The leaves on them were washed and chopped into pieces for later use.
Heat the pot over fire, add the lard picked from the pig legs today, simmer slowly, and remove the oil residue.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, stir them up with chopsticks, and pour them into the hot oil pan.
Stir constantly with chopsticks until the egg liquid in the pot turns into broken eggs.
The chopped eggs need to be tender to taste. After solidification, the fire can be stopped, and the residual heat at the bottom of the pot will continue to heat.
Ye Wanqiu poured in the chopped wild vegetables and the lard residue that he had just fished out. After a little mixing, the aroma of the stuffing came out.
This little stuffing is delicious in dumplings, buns, and shoe soles!
Add cold water to flour and stir into dough. Knead it with your hands into a relatively soft dough. You are ready to roll out the dough and make dumplings.
Ye Wanqiu kneaded the dough into evenly sized balls. When he was about to roll out the dough, he realized that there was no rolling pin.
She wandered around and landed on an unused bamboo in the yard.
It's round and barely usable.
Ye Wanqiu worked hard to break it into a suitable length, use a knife to slightly trim the uneven areas, boil it in boiling water, and the simplest rolling pin was ready.
She moved a chair and sat in front of the table, rolling out dough and making dumplings...
In modern times, she often does this kind of thing.
The grandchildren like to eat the big shrimp dumplings she makes. Ye Wanqiu goes to the seafood market early in the morning to buy the freshest shrimps, clean them and peel them off by himself.
The corn is fresh from the vegetable market, and the corn kernels are peeled off by hand when you buy it.
The pork also needs to be the freshest, so that the meat filling will be fresh and sweet.
The old man said that the minced meat from the meat grinder was not tasty and that a kitchen knife was needed to make the stuffed meat more fragrant.
But when Ye Wanqiu asked them to help, everyone had their own things to do.
In the end, the job of chopping the meat fell on Ye Wanqiu.
In the living room were the laughter of her grandchildren playing, the sound of movies and TV series on the TV, and the noise of short videos. She was the only one standing in the kitchen, rolling out the dough one by one, wrapping it one by one...
Although she was the only one in the thatched house now, Ye Wanqiu felt different.
Mingming was not very familiar with Youxing and the others, and they were very unfamiliar with this world, but Ye Wanqiu felt that this place was warmer than 'home'.
Soon, the chubby dumplings were neatly placed on the chopping board.
Boil water and add the dumplings after the water boils.
When all the dumplings become round and float on the boiling water, it means they are cooked.
The dumplings with vegetarian fillings don't need to be cooked for too long, just roll them in a few times and they'll be done.
Ye Wanqiu took out the dumplings and signaled to Xia Jingjing to tell them that dinner was ready.
Soon, Xia Jingjing's figure appeared in the yard.
"Mother-in-law! What are you going to eat tonight?"
"Dumplings!" Ye Wanqiu showed her the dumplings on the table. They were all round and plump, and the fillings could be vaguely seen through the skin.
Xia Jingjing couldn't help but swallowed: "This is too fragrant..."
Ye Wanqiu's eyes fell behind her, "Jingjing, why are you alone? Where are Xiang Yang and Xiao Zhan? Are you not having dinner?"
"Senior Brother Cui is refining elixirs. He said that he must guard them all the time, otherwise the refining will be easy to break. Those medicinal materials seem to be quite expensive. Senior Brother Chen is practicing swordsmanship. What do you call it? He forgets to eat and sleep!"
She couldn't do it anyway. No one in the sect could cook before, and even the cooked food was not delicious.
Now that the mother-in-law has come back with them, the food cooked is still so delicious, who can resist it.
Ye Wanqiu was silent for a moment, then said: "Bring Jingjing back to them. Refining alchemy and sword practice are so tiring. How can you not eat? And that little star, you need to eat in seclusion, right? You can also bring her one..."
